verses.text: 'I have come into my garden, my sister, [my] bride; I have gathered my myrrh along with my balsam. I have eaten my honeycomb and my honey; I have drunk my wine and my milk. Eat, friends; Drink and imbibe deeply, O lovers.'
verses.textZh: 我妹子，我新婦，我進了我的園中，採了我的沒藥和香料，吃了我的蜜房和蜂蜜，喝了我的酒和奶。（耶路撒冷的眾女子）我的朋友們，請吃！我所親愛的，請喝，且多多地喝！

verses.text: 'I was asleep but my heart was awake. A voice! My beloved was knocking: 'Open to me, my sister, my darling, My dove, my perfect one! For my head is drenched with dew, My locks with the damp of the night.'
verses.textZh: 我身睡臥，我心卻醒。這是我良人的聲音；他敲門說：（新郎）我的妹子，我的佳偶，我的鴿子，我的完全人，求你給我開門；因我的頭滿了露水，我的頭髮被夜露滴濕。（新娘）

verses.text: 'I have taken off my dress, How can I put it on [again]? I have washed my feet, How can I dirty them [again]?
verses.textZh: 我回答說：我脫了衣裳，怎能再穿上呢？我洗了腳，怎能再玷污呢？

verses.text: 'My beloved extended his hand through the opening, And my feelings were aroused for him.
verses.textZh: 我的良人從門孔裡伸進手來，我便因他動了心。

verses.text: 'I arose to open to my beloved; And my hands dripped with myrrh, And my fingers with liquid myrrh, On the handles of the bolt.
verses.textZh: 我起來，要給我良人開門。我的兩手滴下沒藥；我的指頭有沒藥汁滴在門閂上。

verses.text: 'I opened to my beloved, But my beloved had turned away [and] had gone! My heart went out [to him] as he spoke. I searched for him but I did not find him; I called him but he did not answer me.
verses.textZh: 我給我的良人開了門；我的良人卻已轉身走了。他說話的時候，我神不守舍；我尋找他，竟尋不見；我呼叫他，他卻不回答。

verses.text: 'The watchmen who make the rounds in the city found me, They struck me [and] wounded me; The guardsmen of the walls took away my shawl from me.
verses.textZh: 城中巡邏看守的人遇見我，打了我，傷了我；看守城牆的人奪去我的披肩。

verses.text: 'I adjure you, O daughters of Jerusalem, If you find my beloved, As to what you will tell him: For I am lovesick.'
verses.textZh: 耶路撒冷的眾女子啊，我囑咐你們：若遇見我的良人，要告訴他，我因思愛成病。（耶路撒冷的眾女子）

verses.text: 'What kind of beloved is your beloved, O most beautiful among women? What kind of beloved is your beloved, That thus you adjure us?'
verses.textZh: 你這女子中極美麗的，你的良人比別人的良人有何強處？你的良人比別人的良人有何強處，你就這樣囑咐我們？（新娘）

verses.text: 'My beloved is dazzling and ruddy, Outstanding among ten thousand.
verses.textZh: 我的良人白而且紅，超乎萬人之上。

verses.text: 'His head is [like] gold, pure gold; His locks are [like] clusters of dates [And] black as a raven.
verses.textZh: 他的頭像至精的金子；他的頭髮厚密纍垂，黑如烏鴉。

verses.text: 'His eyes are like doves Beside streams of water, Bathed in milk, [And] reposed in [their] setting.
verses.textZh: 他的眼如溪水旁的鴿子眼，用奶洗淨，安得合式。

verses.text: 'His cheeks are like a bed of balsam, Banks of sweet-scented herbs; His lips are lilies Dripping with liquid myrrh.
verses.textZh: 他的兩腮如香花畦，如香草臺；他的嘴唇像百合花，且滴下沒藥汁。

verses.text: 'His hands are rods of gold Set with beryl; His abdomen is carved ivory Inlaid with sapphires.
verses.textZh: 他的兩手好像金管，鑲嵌水蒼玉；他的身體如同雕刻的象牙，周圍鑲嵌藍寶石。

verses.text: 'His legs are pillars of alabaster Set on pedestals of pure gold; His appearance is like Lebanon Choice as the cedars.
verses.textZh: 他的腿好像白玉石柱，安在精金座上；他的形狀如利巴嫩，且佳美如香柏樹。

verses.text: 'His mouth is [full of] sweetness. And he is wholly desirable. This is my beloved and this is my friend, O daughters of Jerusalem.'
verses.textZh: 他的口極其甘甜；他全然可愛。耶路撒冷的眾女子啊，這是我的良人；這是我的朋友。
